name: synaps-switch
description: Puts Synaps sessions into Switch rooms over the Switch agent protocol: one pinned session per room, addressed messages delivered as events, tools to post, read and call any Switch operation.
author: Haseeb Khalid

config.description: The Synaps base dir of the daemon this runs in (its run/ and daemon socket). Extensions get no SYNAPS_BASE_DIR, so set it for any non-default base dir.
